description: One message, two deliveries. notification publishes it on the Redis `notifications` channel and sends the same bytes as a Web Push payload. socket routes it by domainName; the frontend bell renders type, message and timestamp; the service worker renders title, message and icon.

rules.type: Severity, a closed set: info | warning | danger. It is not the metric: that is a preference's notificationType.
rules.domainName: Absent means a system-wide message, broadcast to every client. Present means only that domain's room receives it.
rules.icon: Optional. The service worker shows an icon only when one is sent.
rules.timestamp: ISO-8601 in UTC with milliseconds, not epoch milliseconds.
